items.headline: قائد الجيش اللبناني يؤكد التزام الجيش بإنجاح قرارات السلطة السياسية واستكمال الانتشار في الجنوب وحصر السلاح بيد الدولة
items.body: في أمر اليوم بمناسبة الذكرى 83 للاستقلال، شدد قائد الجيش العماد رودولف هيكل على أن الجيش يواصل تنفيذ مهماته رغم الصعوبات، ويعمل على استكمال انتشاره في الجنوب وبسط سلطة الدولة على كامل الأراضي اللبنانية، مع ضرورة حصر السلاح بيد الدولة. كما أشار إلى أهمية الجهوزية مع اقتراب انتهاء مهام اليونيفيل، واستمرار مراقبة الحدود ومكافحة الإرهاب والتهريب، ودعا إلى الحفاظ على الوحدة الوطنية وعدم الانجرار وراء محاولات التحريض.

items.headline: وزير الصناعة يحدد أصول وشروط منح الشهادة الصناعية والإفادة الصناعية لاستيراد الآلات
items.body: أصدر وزير الصناعة جو عيسى الخوري القرار رقم 87/1 الذي ينظم شروط وإجراءات منح الشهادة الصناعية والإفادة الصناعية، ويحدد صلاحيتها والمستندات المطلوبة، ويوضح أن الشهادة لا تمنح حقاً مكتسباً دائماً ويمكن إلغاؤها في حال مخالفة الشروط، كما تتيح الإفادة الصناعية إعفاءات جمركية لاستيراد المعدات الصناعية للمصانع المرخصة.

items.headline: مداهمات أمنية في بيروت وجبل لبنان وتوقيف أفراد ثلاث شبكات لترويج المخدرات
items.body: نفذت شعبة المعلومات كمائن ومداهمات في برج حمود والسبتية وبئر حسن بتاريخي 3 و10 تشرين الثاني 2026، أوقفت خلالها أفراد ثلاث شبكات لترويج المخدرات بالجرم المشهود، وضبطت كميات من المخدرات وأسلحة ومبالغ مالية، وأصيب أحد الموقوفين خلال تبادل إطلاق نار مع القوى الأمنية.

items.headline: هزة أرضية بقوة 2.5 درجات تضرب منطقة الباروك – الشوف
items.body: أعلن المركز الوطني للجيوفيزياء تسجيل هزة أرضية بقوة 2.5 درجات على مقياس ريختر عند الساعة 00:42 من فجر 19 تشرين الثاني 2026 في منطقة الباروك – الشوف.

items.headline: الضمان الاجتماعي يدّعي على شركة وهمية وخمسة أجراء وهميين بتهم التزوير وهدر المال العام
items.body: تقدمت إدارة الصندوق الوطني للضمان الاجتماعي بادعاء جزائي أمام النيابة العامة المالية بحق شركة تاج كويين وخمسة أجراء وهميين، بعد كشف تسجيلهم للاستفادة غير القانونية من تقديمات الضمان، وتم شطب الشركة والأجراء واسترداد الأموال المقبوضة دون وجه حق.

items.headline: Google DeepMind launches Gemini 4 Neon, ranking #2 on Vals Index and #3 on Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index; users praise writing and teaching ability
items.body: Gemini 4 Neon is positioned between Carbon and Hydrogen in Google's Gemini 4 lineup, offering a 1M-token context window and pricing at $3 per million input tokens and $15 per million output tokens. On Google's own benchmarks, Neon leads 16 of 19 rows against Claude Opus 5.5 and GPT-6.2 Sol. Independent leaderboards place Neon second on the Vals Index (70.9%) behind Claude Fable 5.2, and third on Artificial Analysis's chart, behind Claude Fable 5.2 and GPT-6.2 Astra. Artificial Analysis notes Neon is slow and verbose but competitive in intelligence and cost per test. The model is available via Gemini API paid tier, Gemini for business, Google Antigravity, and the Gemini app for Pro and Ultra subscribers. Several users report that Gemini 4 Neon stands out among current frontier models for its human-like writing and effectiveness at teaching, with some calling it the best model Google or any company has released to date.

items.headline: OpenAI releases GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol, reporting improved results on demanding tasks and lower costs
items.body: OpenAI states that GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol deliver better results on demanding tasks with fewer output tokens. On OpenAI's benchmarks, Astra leads five of nine rows that include Claude models, while Claude Fable 5.2 leads three. Astra is priced 20% below GPT-6 Astra, and both models offer a 1,050,000-token context window. Artificial Analysis ranks GPT-6.2 Astra second on its Intelligence Index, behind Claude Fable 5.2. OpenAI reports tighter cyber safeguards and notes a pre-launch jailbreak finding by the UK AI Security Institute, which OpenAI believes is now mitigated but not yet independently validated.

items.headline: OpenAI details model-driven chip design improvements, including estimated 13% and 10% area reductions in Jalapeño blocks and up to 14% gains on AMD GPU IP
items.body: OpenAI reports its models reduced standard-cell area by about 13% in the vector unit and 10% in the matrix unit of its Jalapeño inference chip, with optimizations proven in silicon. The company also claims up to 14% improvement on AMD's flagship GPU IP, with some model-written changes included in AMD designs sent for manufacturing. These figures are OpenAI's own and not independently confirmed by AMD.

items.headline: OpenAI reports surge in agentic AI use by researchers, but says uplift is uneven and calls for mandatory RSI reporting
items.body: OpenAI's latest report states the median researcher now uses about $2,400 per day of agentic AI at API list prices, up 62% since September, with the 90th percentile at $23,000. Agent workdays per researcher rose elevenfold, but OpenAI notes these are input/activity measures, not direct progress. The company proposes labs be required to publicly report recursive self-improvement indicators.

items.headline: Commons committee recommends UK AI Safety and Security Bill and statutory AI regulator
items.body: A UK House of Commons committee report calls for an AI Safety and Security Bill and a statutory AI regulator separate from the AI Safety Institute. The report identifies ten critical gaps in the UK's AI safety framework, including lack of statutory powers for model access, mandatory incident reporting, and powers to delay or prohibit deployment. It recommends mandatory reporting of frontier AI incidents and independent scrutiny before releasing high-risk open-weight models. The recommendations are not yet government policy.

items.headline: Microsoft introduces MAI Code 2 coding models in GitHub Copilot, claiming near-GPT-6.1 Sol performance at lower cost
items.body: Microsoft's MAI Code 2 and Code 2 Flash models are now available in GitHub Copilot. Microsoft claims MAI Code 2 achieves 98% of GPT-6.1 Sol's coding performance at 40% of the price, based on its own benchmarks. The models are not yet tuned for long-horizon agentic work. Benchmark results are self-reported and not independently verified.

items.headline: Google Labs opens waitlist for Stitch Loop, an experimental agent that opens pull requests on shipped code
items.body: Stitch Loop is a long-running product agent that connects to a codebase and live metrics, running built-in security, latency, and accessibility loops. It opens GitHub pull requests for human review before merging fixes. The experiment is waitlist-only, with no public benchmarks or pricing yet.

items.headline: OpenAI explains Codex sandbox defaults and limitations for coding agent security
items.body: OpenAI's engineering blog details Codex's permission profiles, which allow writes in the workspace and broad reads subject to OS permissions, but block network access by default. Harmful actions remain possible, such as planting malicious code in local packages or accessing readable secrets outside the workspace. The sandbox is one layer of defense, with platform-specific implementations and acknowledged gaps.

items.headline: Carnegie Mellon and Stanford release public dataset mapping a highly concentrated AI supply chain
items.body: Researchers find the AI industry network is highly concentrated, especially in compute and hardware, with Google, NVIDIA, Microsoft, OpenAI, and Anthropic among the most central actors. The dataset, built from public documents, is available on Hugging Face and at aisupplychains.org, but is necessarily incomplete and biased toward large model providers.
